caption: The drawing depicts a small, rectangular wooden structure with a pitched roof, colored mostly in shades of brown and gray with red trim along the roof edges and structural joints. The walls of the structure have a lattice pattern, with some panels oriented diagonally and others vertically, and there are two arched openings on the longer side. In front of the structure, a brown animal resembling a donkey or horse stands on a rectangular brown base. The animal has its front legs raised and placed on what appears to be a grayish feed trough positioned near the building entrance. The background is a plain off-white color with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Toy Bank
